## 1.1 Training and Testing Sets

We split the data by map rather than by individual round. This prevents rounds from the same map from appearing in both the training and testing sets.

```{r train-test-split}
data <- clean_data(sample_rounds,
                   sample_kills,
                   historical_team_points,
                   log_scale_equip_gap = FALSE,
                   log_scale_skill_gap = TRUE,
                   include_pistol = FALSE
                   ) |>
  train_validate_test_split(seed = 0318)

train_data <- data$train_data
validate_data <- data$validate_data
test_data <- data$train_data
```

```{r models}
ls <- lm(team_1_win ~ map_and_team_1_side + team_1_equip_gap + team_1_points_gap, data = train_data)
lr <- glm(team_1_win ~ map_and_team_1_side + team_1_equip_gap + team_1_points_gap, data = train_data, family = "binomial")
rf <- ranger(team_1_win ~ map_name + team_1_side + team_1_equip_gap + team_1_points_gap, data = train_data)
```


```{r}
lr_formula <- team_1_win ~ map_and_team_1_side + team_1_equip_gap + team_1_points_gap

set.seed(27398)

# Bootstrap by sampling maps, not individual rounds
boot_coefs <- map_df(1:100, function(i) {
  print(i)

  rounds_boot <- train_data |>
    group_by(file_name) |>
    group_split() |>
    sample(
      size = n_distinct(train_data$file_name),
      replace = TRUE
    ) |>
    bind_rows()

  lr_all_boot <- glm(
    lr_formula,
    data = rounds_boot,
    family = "binomial"
  )

  enframe(
    lr_all_boot$coefficients,
    name = "variable",
    value = "coefficient"
  )
}, .id = "boot")

coefs_std <- boot_coefs |>
  group_by(variable) |>
  summarise(boot_sd = sd(coefficient)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  left_join(enframe(lr$coefficients,
                    name = "variable",
                    value = "coefficient") |>
                      mutate(theory_sd = summary(lr)$coef[,2]),
            by = "variable") |>
  mutate(standardized_coefficient = coefficient / boot_sd) |>
  arrange(desc(abs(standardized_coefficient))) |>
  filter(variable != "(Intercept)") |>
  select(variable, coefficient, boot_sd, theory_sd, standardized_coefficient)
print(coefs_std, width = Inf)
```

```{r}
pred_val_sample <- validate_data |>
  transmute(team_1_win = team_1_win,
            ls_predict = predict(ls, validate_data),
            ls_confidence = 2 * abs(ls_predict - 0.5),
            
            ls_predict_binary = if_else(ls_predict > 0.5, TRUE, FALSE),
            ls_correct = if_else(team_1_win == ls_predict_binary, TRUE, FALSE),
            lr_predict = predict(lr, validate_data, type = "response"),
            lr_confidence = 2 * abs(lr_predict - 0.5),
            lr_predict_binary = if_else(lr_predict > 0.5, TRUE, FALSE),
            lr_correct = if_else(team_1_win == lr_predict_binary, TRUE, FALSE),
            rf_predict_binary = predict(rf, validate_data)$predictions,
            rf_correct = if_else(team_1_win == rf_predict_binary, TRUE, FALSE)
            )

pred_val_sample

table(pred_val_sample$team_1_win, pred_val_sample$ls_predict_binary)
table(pred_val_sample$team_1_win, pred_val_sample$lr_predict_binary)
table(pred_val_sample$team_1_win, pred_val_sample$rf_predict_binary)
```




```{r}
pred_val_long <- pred_val_sample |> 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = matches("^(ls|lr)_"),
    names_to = c("method", ".value"),
    names_pattern = "^(ls|lr)_(.*)$"
  )

pred_val_long |> ggplot(aes(x = confidence)) +
  geom_histogram(aes(fill = correct), alpha = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ method)
```

```{r}
pred_val_long |> ggplot(aes(x = predict)) +
  geom_histogram(aes(fill = team_1_win), alpha = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ method)
```

```{r}
pred_val_sample |> select(team_1_win, ls_predict, lr_predict) |>
  mutate(team_1_win = factor(team_1_win, levels = c(TRUE, FALSE))) |>
  pivot_longer(c("ls_predict", "lr_predict"), names_to = "fit", values_to = "pred") |>
  group_by(fit) |> roc_curve(team_1_win, pred) |> autoplot()
```

```{r}
pred_val_sample |>
  select(team_1_win, ls_predict, lr_predict) |>
  mutate(team_1_win = factor(team_1_win, levels = c(TRUE, FALSE))) |>
  pivot_longer(c("ls_predict", "lr_predict"),
               names_to = "fit", values_to = "pred") |>
  group_by(fit) |>
  summarise(auc = roc_auc_vec(truth = team_1_win, estimate = pred))
```

```{r}
calibration_results <- validate_data |>
  mutate(
    predicted = predict(lr, newdata = validate_data, type = "response"),
    actual = as.numeric(team_1_win),
    probability_group = ntile(predicted, 1000)
  ) |>
  group_by(probability_group) |>
  summarise(
    N = n(),
    predicted_probability = mean(predicted),
    observed_probability = mean(actual),
    lower = binom.test(sum(actual), n())$conf.int[1],
    upper = binom.test(sum(actual), n())$conf.int[2],
    .groups = "drop"
  )

calibration_results

ggplot(
  calibration_results,
  aes(x = predicted_probability, y = observed_probability)
) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper),
    width = 0.01,
    alpha = 0.2
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 1) +
  geom_abline(
    slope = 1,
    intercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  coord_equal(xlim = c(0, 1), ylim = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(
    title = "Model Calibration",
    x = "Predicted Win Probability",
    y = "Observed Win Probability"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

# Stability Check
```{r}
data_options <- expand_grid(
  log_scale_equip_gap = c(FALSE, TRUE),
  log_scale_skill_gap = c(FALSE, TRUE),
  include_pistol = c(FALSE, TRUE)
) |>
  mutate(
    data = pmap(
      list(
        log_scale_equip_gap,
        log_scale_skill_gap,
        include_pistol
      ),
      \(equip, skill, pistol) {
        clean_data(
          sample_rounds,
          sample_kills,
          historical_team_points,
          equip,
          skill,
          pistol
        )
      }
    )
  )

data_options <- data_options |>
  mutate(
    split = map(data, train_validate_test_split)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    train_data = map(split, "train_data"),
    validate_data = map(split, "validate_data"),
    test_data = map(split, "test_data")
  )

data_options <- data_options |>
  mutate(
    results = pmap(
      list(train_data, validate_data, test_data),
      \(train_data, validate_data, test_data) {

        train_data <- train_data |>
          drop_na(team_1_win)

        test_data <- test_data |>
          drop_na(team_1_win)

        # Linear regression
        ls <- lm(
          team_1_win ~ map_and_team_1_side +
            team_1_equip_gap +
            team_1_points_gap,
          data = train_data
        )

        # Logistic regression
        lr <- glm(
          team_1_win ~ map_and_team_1_side +
            team_1_equip_gap +
            team_1_points_gap,
          data = train_data,
          family = binomial()
        )

        # Random forest
        rf <- ranger(
          team_1_win ~ map_name +
            team_1_side +
            team_1_equip_gap +
            team_1_points_gap,
          data = train_data |>
            mutate(team_1_win = factor(
              team_1_win,
              levels = c(FALSE, TRUE)
            )),
          probability = TRUE,
          num.trees = 500,
          seed = 0318
        )

        # Predictions
        predictions <- tibble(
          actual = as.integer(test_data$team_1_win),
          ls = predict(ls, newdata = test_data),
          lr = predict(lr, newdata = test_data, type = "response"),
          rf = predict(rf, data = test_data)$predictions[, "TRUE"]
        ) |>
          pivot_longer(
            cols = c(ls, lr, rf),
            names_to = "method",
            values_to = "pred"
          ) |>
          mutate(
            pred_binary = as.integer(pred >= 0.5),
            pred_correct = pred_binary == actual
          )

        list(
          models = list(ls = ls, lr = lr, rf = rf),
          predictions = predictions
        )
      }
    )
  )
```
